session_check: amc, NOT the baseline's defaulted bmo. The issuer's 2026 calendar, filed on the AMF flux on 18 Dec 2025, lists '24 septembre 2026 - Publication des résultats semestriels au 30 juin 2026' (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/BWR/2025/12/FCBWR165896_20251218.pdf). The calendar gives no hour. Every Adocia regulated release in 2026 on the AMF flux is stamped 18h00 CEST (16:00 UTC), after the 17:35 close. That covers the Q2 release on 23 July, 1 Sept, 10 Sept and 17 Sept. The H1 2025 résultats semestriels went out at 2025-09-25T16:00Z on the same pattern (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/BWR/2025/09/FCBWR164726_20250925.pdf). The reacting window is therefore close 2026-09-24 -> close 2026-09-25. The baseline's bmo window (close 09-23 -> close 09-24) contains no release.

Advances can also be repaid in cash, so the cap does not remove the runway the company stated. Not a finding.

language_note: The French AMF flux carried the monthly share-count filings showing the Vester Finance share issuance by month (200k May, 245k June, 200k July, 0 August), which the English wire copy does not itemise; it changed no size.

The French 18 Dec 2025 calendar filing on the AMF flux is the primary document confirming 24 Sept for the résultats semestriels, and the AMF timestamps (all 18h00 CEST) are what settled the session as amc; English aggregators carried the date but not the hour.

Not French, but the non-English source that carried the most: Tonghua Dongbao's Chinese H1 2026 report states the China NDA is still being prepared, as of 25 Aug. No English source carries this, and it confirms rather than contradicts Adocia's own 'in preparation' language.
